en.bdb: Wasting the life by the gambler

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਨਸ ਦੇਹਿ ਦੁਲੰਭੁ ਹੈ ਜੁਗਹ ਜੁਗੰਤਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਵਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: maanas dheh dhula(n)bh hai jugeh juga(n)tar aavai vaaree|

en.bdb: After many ages comes the turn of assuming the human body.

verses.gurmukhi: ਉਤਮ ਜਨਮੁ ਦੁਲੰਭੁ ਹੈ ਇਕ ਵਾਕੀ ਕੋੜਮਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: autam janam dhula(n)bh hai ik vaakee koRamaa veechaaree|

en.bdb: It is a rare boon to be born in a family of truthful and intelligent people.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੇਹਿ ਅਰੋਗ ਦੁਲੰਭੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਗਠੁ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਹਿਤਕਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: dheh arog dhula(n)bh hai bhaagaTh maat pitaa hitakaaree|

en.bdb: Almost rare to be healthy and to have beneficent and fortunate parents who can take care of the well-being of the child.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਦੁਲੰਭੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਫਲ ਭਗਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: saadhoo sa(n)g dhula(n)bh hai gurmukh sukhafal bhagat piaaree|

en.bdb: Also rare is the holy congregation and loving devotion, the pleasure fruit of gurrnukhs.

verses.gurmukhi: ਫਾਥਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਹਾਂ ਜਾਲਿ ਪੰਜ ਦੂਤ ਜਮਕਾਲ ਸੁ ਭਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: faathaa maiaa mahaa(n) jaal pa(n)j dhoot jamakaal su bhaaree|

en.bdb: But the Jiv, caught in the web of five evil propensities bears the heavy punishment of Yama, the god of death.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਸਹਾ ਵਹੀਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਰ ਹਥਿ ਪਾਸਾ ਪਉਛਕਿ ਸਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: jiau kar sahaa vaheer vich par hath paasaa pauchhak saaree|

en.bdb: The state of  jiv becomes the same as that of a hare caught in a crowd. The dice being in other's hand the whole game goes topsyturvy.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਕੁਦਾਇਅੜ ਜਮ ਜੰਦਾਰੁ ਸਾਰ ਸਿਰ ਮਾਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: dhoojai bhai kudhaiaR jam ja(n)dhaar saar sir maaree|

en.bdb: The mace of Yama falls on the head of a jiv who gambles about in duality.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਵੈ ਜਾਏ ਭਵਾਈਐ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: aavai jaae bhavaieeaai bhavajal a(n)dhar hoi khuaaree|

en.bdb: Such a creature entangled in the cycle of the transmigration goes on suffering disgrace in the world-ocean.
Like a gambler he loses and wastes his precious life.
